artifact_policy: Every warmup and timed product validated outside clocks; formal product hashes retained in observations; representative exact qualification payloads persisted, repeated formal payload bytes not archived.

effective_profile.cuda_context_scope: library/device initialization outside object clocks; new interpreter per experiment session
effective_profile.gpu_allocation_scope: source-accounted simultaneous adapter-owned requested allocation capacity; excludes CUDA context/runtime/cache, allocator granularity and pre-existing prepared owners; not a sampled VRAM peak
effective_profile.gpu_event_scope: completed CUDA stream work: scratch/output zeroing, host-path H2D when present, FIXED kernel and encoded rate/size D2H; not kernel-only

host_memory_limit.scope: host process virtual address space, including driver mappings; not RSS

runtime.gpu_scope: actual mapped CUDA runtime/driver/NVIDIA libraries plus build runtime dependencies and explicit preload

effective_profile.thread_definition: adapter algorithm host parallelism; excludes driver/runtime helper threads
effective_profile.thread_evidence: adapter has no algorithm host thread pool; driver/runtime process Threads are observed separately

vram_limit.reason: no enforceable per-process VRAM budget API in this adapter; allocation accounting is separate
